definitions.gloss: to leave alone; to let be; to leave someone/something as is
definitions.explanation: To deliberately not interfere with or attend to someone or something. Can imply either benign neglect (giving space) or irresponsible neglect depending on context.

examples.japanese: {放|ほう}っておいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}っておく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you leave a cold untreated, it'll get worse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泣|な}いている→泣く：00655_naku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}っておくわけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't just leave a crying child alone.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Often pronounced ほっとく in casual speech, contracting ほうっておく → ほっておく → ほっとく.

Godan verb (⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ row, via おく): {放|ほう}っておく
て-form: ⟦{放|ほう}って→放る：03939_houru⟧おいて
た-form: ⟦{放|ほう}って→放る：03939_houru⟧おいた
Casual: ほっとく・ほっといて・ほっといた

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{放|ほう}って→放る：03939_houru⟧おいて⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ (Leave me alone)
- ⟦{放|ほう}って→放る：03939_houru⟧おけない (can't leave it alone / can't ignore it)
- {放|ほう}っておくわけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない (can't just leave it)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ほったらかす→ほったらかす：21542_hottarakasu⟧: More colloquial and implies careless neglect. Stronger negative nuance than {放|ほう}っておく.
- ⟦{見|み}{逃|のが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧: To overlook, to let slide — focuses on failing to notice rather than deliberately ignoring.
